name: Resonant Minaret
summary: A tall minaret and small prayer hall share one line, accompanied by two generous adhan arcs.
why: The minaret is continuous from its rounded crown to the shared foundation. The hall dome and its doorway share the x43 centerline. The call arcs share the tower vocal axis at y46 and remain deliberately separated from the architecture.
risk: The sound arcs convey the adhan clearly, but can also suggest audio features; the mosque anchors their meaning.
sub2: The call extending into the day
reasonToChoose: You want the daily call to prayer to be the strongest message.
